title: VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 Replaces MGNREGA — Wage Guarantee Raised to 125 Days
summary: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act 2025 replaces MGNREGA 2005, raising annual wage days from 100 to 125.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 Replaces MGNREGA — Wage Guarantee Raised to 125 Days. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Ministry of Rural Development replaced the 20-year-old MGNREGA with the **Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (VB-G RAM G Act)**.
**Key Shift**: Statutory wage employment guarantee raised from **100 days to 125 days per financial year** for rural households.
**Minister**: Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on 125-day wage guarantee expansion, minimum statutory wage rate (₹300/day), and replacement of MGNREGA 2005.
